item.description:
Release v5.15.0

Changes since v5.14.0

  • docs: add bug audit report (2026-08)
  • docs: add UI performance audit report (2026-08)
  • feat: add conversationDidCreate event for precise new conversation notifications
  • feat: add standalone OpenCode Go provider plugin
  • feat(context-size): refresh context size on conversation creation
  • feat(conversation-speed): keep speed chip visible with unavailable state when no conversation selected
  • feat(opencode-go): 支持注入 LLMAPIService 使请求进入 HTTP 交换记录
  • feat(opencode-go): parse and persist token usage from non-streaming responses
  • feat(quick-launcher): rebuild as Raycast-style global launcher with hotkey and federated search
  • feat(rail): show exclusive rail tabs only when container owns one
  • feat(resume-designer): add agent-built resume plugin with print-optimized PDF/PNG export
  • fix(message-renderer): only show error summary in info popover for actual errors
  • fix(opencode-go): fill latencyMs/TTFT metrics so ConversationSpeed works
  • fix(promo-designer): configure storage when plugin is enabled at runtime
  • refactor: extract token formatting utilities and simplify event observers in ConversationContextSizePlugin
  • refactor: Migrate Add Custom Provider sheet to LumiUI components
  • refactor(conversation-speed): shorten file names by dropping ConversationSpeed prefix
  • refactor(conversation-speed): split toolbar view into models, extensions and views
  • refactor(minimax): move token plan from status bar to chat toolbar
  • refactor(opencode-go): reformat provider and set 1M context window for deepseek-v4-flash
